name: Asnath Mahapa flies high
shortDescription: Lebo interviews Captain Asnath Mahapa for his school magazine and meets South Africa's first Black female pilot.
longDescription: In a school-magazine interview, Lebo meets Captain Asnath Mahapa and learns about the pioneering pilot whose achievements opened new possibilities in South African aviation.

attribution.author: Sara Lekganyane
